The mishna taught that the *Ammonite* and *Moabite* converts are among those who say the blessing over the first fruits but do not read the declaration. The baraita continues: *But when he prays in private, he recites* the formula of the first blessing of the *Amida* as follows: *God of our fathers,* meaning God of the forefathers of the Jewish people. If *his mother is Jewish, he says: God of our fathers,* as he is Jewish by birth. If his mother is a gentile, he says: God of the fathers of the Jewish people, but not: God of our fathers.
